report_metadata.sdlc_rationale: Deadline fixed (June 30, 2026) and requirements fully defined with signed stakeholders, but integration complexity with Workday/Azure AD and new team experience with React/Node stack warrant adaptive sprint cycles within predictive phase gates.

project_understanding.primary_goal: Build a self-service employee onboarding portal enabling new hires to complete required paperwork, provision IT accounts, and receive team introductions before day one.
project_understanding.beneficiary: New employees (100–200/year) and HR team (5 people)
project_understanding.trigger: Current onboarding is fragmented across PDF-based paperwork, manual IT account setup, and unprepared new hires; CEO requested HR fix after hearing complaints at all-hands.
success_definition: 80% of onboarding tasks completed by new hires before day one
50% reduction in HR admin time spent on onboarding
IT account setup fully automated (zero manual tickets)
supporting_quotes: Create a self-service employee onboarding portal that allows new hires to complete all required paperwork, set up their IT accounts, and get introduced to the team before day one.
Currently onboarding is fragmented - paperwork is PDF-based, IT account setup is manual, new hires feel unprepared on day one.
New hires can complete 80% of onboarding tasks before day one
HR time spent on onboarding admin reduced by 50%
IT account setup automated (no manual tickets)

assumption_log.what: Workday API sandbox environment, documentation, and SLA are available and stable; integration does not require custom Workday configuration beyond standard employee data export.
assumption_log.why: External API integrations are common failure points in internal tool projects. Workday is enterprise-grade but integration scope (pre-population vs. real-time sync) materially affects architecture and timeline.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 8.1 (Scope Management) and Section 12.1 (Integration Management)
assumption_log.consequence: If Workday API requires custom configuration, custom field mapping, or sandbox is unavailable, Phase 2 integration work extends 2–4 weeks; if real-time sync required instead of batch, architecture must shift to event-driven model.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Unblocks Phase 2 integration work on schedule; enables pre-population of new hire data. Risks: If API unavailable or requires custom work, team must pivot to manual data entry or delay launch.

assumption_log.what: Azure AD provisioning API and Slack/SaaS tool SCIM integrations are documented, tested, and do not require custom connector development; IT Administrator has or can quickly gain hands-on experience with Azure AD automation.
assumption_log.why: IT account provisioning (UC4) is marked 'complex' in use case model and is a critical path item. Azure AD is standard but automation scope (email-only vs. full SaaS provisioning) and team familiarity materially affect Phase 2 timeline and risk.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 9.3 (Resource Management) and Section 12.1 (Integration Management)
assumption_log.consequence: If Azure AD provisioning requires custom scripting or IT team lacks automation experience, Phase 2 integration extends 3–6 weeks; if Slack/SaaS integrations lack SCIM support, manual provisioning workflows must be built or scope reduced.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Unblocks automated account provisioning on schedule; enables 'zero manual tickets' success metric. Risks: If integrations require custom development, team must allocate developer capacity away from portal UI or delay launch.

assumption_log.what: E-signature service (UC2) is pre-selected, has documented API, and supports I-9/W-4/direct deposit form templates; no custom legal review or form redesign is required beyond standard onboarding documents.
assumption_log.why: Document e-signature is a must-have feature and involves compliance (SOC 2 audit logs). Service selection and form readiness materially affect Phase 2 scope and legal/compliance sign-off timeline.
assumption_log.consequence: If e-signature service is not yet selected, Phase 1 extends 1–2 weeks for vendor evaluation and legal review; if forms require redesign for compliance, Phase 2 extends 1–3 weeks.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Unblocks document collection workflow; enables compliance audit trail. Risks: If service selection or form review delayed, Phase 1 timeline slips.

hard.technology_stack: Frontend: React + TypeScript; Backend: Node.js + PostgreSQL; Integration: Workday API, Azure AD SSO; Hosting: Azure App Service
hard.compliance: SOC 2 compliance required (audit logs, data handling)

nfr.security: Azure AD SSO for authentication; SOC 2 compliance for audit logs and data handling

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Is the e-signature service (UC2) already selected, or does vendor evaluation need to occur in Phase 1?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: If not selected, Phase 1 extends 1–2 weeks for vendor evaluation and legal review; if forms require redesign, Phase 2 extends 1–3 weeks.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: What is the scope of IT account provisioning (UC4): email-only, or does it include Slack, SaaS tools, and VPN access? Which SaaS tools require provisioning?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Scope creep on integrations directly impacts Phase 2 timeline; unclear SaaS tool list may require re-scoping or delay.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Does Workday API integration require custom field mapping or configuration, or is standard employee data export sufficient for pre-population?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: If custom configuration required, Phase 2 integration work extends 2–4 weeks.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Who is the Product Owner responsible for backlog prioritization and stakeholder trade-off decisions during Phase 2–3 sprints?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Hybrid SDLC requires clear PO authority; absence of PO creates decision bottlenecks and delays sprint execution.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: What is the data retention policy for onboarding documents and audit logs post-completion (e.g., 7 years for I-9 compliance)?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: If retention policy is not defined, database schema and compliance controls may require re-architecture post-launch.
